whatYouWereTold.text: You saw the doctor on 14/10/2026 about your blood pressure readings.
whatYouWereTold.sourceQuote: coming to see me on 14/10/2026 about your blood pressure readings

whatYouWereTold.text: The doctor has started you on a new medicine, Amlodipine 5mg.
whatYouWereTold.sourceQuote: I have started you on Amlodipine 5mg

whatYouWereTold.text: Your prescription will be ready at the pharmacy from tomorrow.
whatYouWereTold.sourceQuote: The pharmacy will have your prescription ready from tomorrow

whatItMeans.plainMeaning: The numbers from measuring how hard your blood pushes against the walls of your blood vessels.
How well your kidneys are working.
A nurse who works at your GP surgery.

nextSteps.action: Collect your prescription from the pharmacy.

nextSteps.action: Book a blood test with the practice nurse.

nextSteps.action: Tell the surgery if you notice swelling in your ankles.

ungrounded.text: Check your blood pressure at home every day.
